In this episode, I sit down with Alejandro and Mario to unpack how their app generates over $30K/month in profit. They break down their exact app development process, from choosing the right app ideas to executing a full app development roadmap. Whether you're new to app development for beginners or experienced in mobile app development, their story offers valuable insights.

We talk about the coding and programming behind the app, what it takes to become a successful software developer, and how their software development and full stack development approach helped them scale fast. Alejandro and Mario also share their business model, how they planned it, and how it turned their business ideas into a profitable reality.

If you've ever wanted to make an app, develop an app, or learn how to create an app from scratch, this conversation gives you the real-world steps. It's packed with practical advice for anyone interested in business, launching new business ideas, or finding the best business ideas in tech today.

They also explain how to make an app that not only works — but makes money. This is a must-listen if you're serious about learning how to make an app and taking action on your next big idea.
